last_scan.note: Deadline-window refresh, 32h remaining. Listed 100 public notebooks by score descending; the frontier is the 0.947/0.953 chain which our 0.960 stack already exceeds, so nothing was adopted wholesale. Three previously unaudited notebooks sorting at or above v3 were source reviewed. The material finding is that amanatar/optimized-biohub-max-score independently loosens the same safe-division gates our own division decomposition identified, which is corroboration from a second direction rather than folklore.

Source reviewed 2026-09-21. Zero exploit-pattern hits. Ships constants IDENTICAL to our base (DET_THRESHOLD 0.965, ILP disappearance 2, appearance 0.0, edge 0.48, GAP_CLOSE 5.0, OUTPUT_MIN_TRACK_LEN 6) plus the density-adaptive mechanism, so its advertised 0.951 comes from a structural change (fast ILP) and not constant tuning. Source reviewed 2026-09-25. Self-describes as "0.953 Record Edition". Integrity screen clean: zero negative-time node assignments, zero hub/FORKS/MAX_COMPONENTS tokens, zero out-of-volume coordinates, and it never writes estimated_number_of_nodes. The single "t": -1 occurrence is the mandated edge-row placeholder ("row_type": "edge", node_id -1, t -1, z/y/x -1), identical to what our own pipeline emits; it also raises AssertionError on dangling edges, which is an integrity check rather than an exploit. NOTE: an earlier screen of this file reported a negative-time flag; that was a false positive caused by an unquoted shell heredoc eating the regex escapes, and was retracted after a clean re-run. Structurally it is a STRICT SUPERSET of our pinned harmonic base: of 54 BIOHUB_* constants our base sets, zero differ in value and zero are absent; v3 adds 31 more across 8 extra cells, on the same three pilkwang model datasets. New mechanisms are MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_* (12 constants, mode=seed K=12 radius=40um tight=7.0), GAPFILL_* (8, allow_synthetic=0, max_added_frac=0.03), READMIT_* (2) and LOWDET_THRESHOLD. Advertised score is not treated as validation evidence; it must be reproduced on the leaderboard before promotion.

No out-of-volume or synthetic-hub construction. The estimated_number_of_nodes and t_pred occurrences are the validator computing the official metric, matching our own base. Corroborates our division hypothesis from an independent direction.
